create_module_from_config: create a PyText module from a module config object using the shared module registry
create_module_with_custom_fn: create a PyText module using a custom creation function instead of the default registry
load_module_from_path: load a PyText module from a saved state dict or torchscripted file path
freeze_module_parameters: freeze all parameters of a PyText Module by setting requires_grad to False
share_module_via_registry: share a PyText module across configs using a shared_module_key in the registry
